text: Pilot hypothesis: evidence collection for sustainability, grants, and partner reporting
description: Map promised outcomes and required evidence to operational sources before they disappear across spreadsheets, chats, photos, invoices, and team memories. Agents request and organize evidence, flag gaps, and draft traceable reports; humans validate claims. Measure report-preparation hours, missing evidence, time to answer funder/partner questions, and grant or sponsorship deadlines met. This is lower operational risk and may directly protect funding, but recurrence and budget ownership must be validated.

status.comment: Awaiting operator evidence on recurrence, budget ownership, authoritative artifacts, baseline, and willingness to pay. Do not build until Felix obtains this evidence in a discovery conversation.

reflection: Relevance check on 29 July 2026: this is a discovery hypothesis, not authorized implementation work. Its description and existing status comment require real operator validation before building. Reclassified from open to human-dependent so autonomous selection preserves the candidate without spending product effort on an unverified workflow.
